prompt: Who was the Prime Minister of Canada in the year that the 1965 winner of the Best New Artist Grammy Award made their first appearance on US television?
answer: The 1965 Best New Artist Grammy winner was **The Beatles**, who made their first U.S. television appearance on *The Ed Sullivan Show* in **1964**. Canada’s Prime Minister that year was **Lester B. Pearson**.
